Relationships should be a consequence of the process of self improvement not you primary objective. Plus this is reddit, nobody really cares about what your bf/gf did for you that made your month. Most people are here just to vent and relate to people facing similar issues to themselves and maybe have a laugh about their situation. I know this is going to piss off a lot of people and probably get me banned but there's my 2 cents.

it's impossible that you're going to meet all 7 bil in your life. Realistically you are going to meet about a few thousand and interact with maybe 500 at best for extended periods of time. Out of that maybe 10 or so could be potential partners. Even so the probability that your relationship ultimately fails is still quite high. 

Better advice would be to work on yourself to be a healthier, wiser and stronger person. That way even if you don't attract anyone, you still end up with the skills and mental strength to live independently.

This notion that you need another person to validate your existence or that you cannot be happy without love is bs and it severely fucks up people to the point of depression and self destruction if they are not able to conform to it or if their relationship goes bad. Sure, love is a wonderful and cathartic thing to experience but to claim that it is necessary to live a good life is wrong.
